hits.snippet: Wednesday, June 24th, 2026 Posted by Jim Thacker # Reallusion releases free animation tool iClone Personal Reallusion has released a new free edition of [iClone](https://www.reallusion.com/iclone/) , its real-time 3D animation software. [iClone Personal](https://www.reallusion.com/iclone/download.html) contains the full toolset of the paid edition, and can be used on commercial projects, but is limited to 30 lifetime exports to other 3D applications. The new free edition was released yesterday alongside the official launch of [AI Studio](https://ai.reallusion.com/ai-studio/default.html) , Reallusion’s 3D-guided AI rendering toolset, which is integrated into it. **Use iClone for free indefinitely, at least for project development** Unlike the old 30-day iClone trial, which it replaces, iClone Personal does not time out, and can be used indefinitely. It has the complete toolset of the paid edition of iClone, has the same render resolutions, and can be used on commercial projects. The limitation is that, while you can export animations to other 3D software or game engines, you can only do so 30 times.
